PLAN · what happens next and why
Next sessions start with a worked example, then steps, then a fresh problem for Leo to try himself.
Why: worked examples and steps have helped Leo on this kind of idea; pictures have not.
Leo may be mixing up which negative number is greater (for example −5 and −1).
More evidence is needed before this is treated as confirmed.
Checked against the recorded evidence before you see it.
What the tutor has learned about each child
Strategy profile: mean success per representation (Beta α,β)
Moves suspected → confirmed → resolved only on repeated evidence.
Mastery: provisional when pKnown ≥ 0.80 with ≥ 2 distinct level-3+ items.
